name: Sound Cast
description: Send a single pulse of soul into the dark and read the shape of the return.

name: Return Read
description: Hold the soul open after a pulse and read how the return bends around each living body.

name: Echo Gauge
description: Gauge the strength of each pulse so that the next one is sent with just enough force.

name: Sounding Guard
description: Keep a thin ringing layer round the mind that turns aside soul touches coming through the dark.

name: Ringing Clear
description: Clear the ringing and dizziness that a shocking soul blast leaves in one ally.

name: Earth Sounding
description: Send pulses down through floors and earth to find hollows and the souls that sit in them.

name: Full Sounding
description: Send a great ring of pulses outward and draw a complete map of every soul and hollow in a wide area.

name: Calling Back
description: Call back the stunned soul of an ally whose breath has just stopped within a few heartbeats of the blow.

name: Tide Feel
description: Feel the slow swell of souls through a crowd and learn which way the crowd leans.

name: Ebb Mark
description: Mark the moment a soul begins to pull back and learn who is about to flee.

name: Tidal Hold
description: Steady the user's own soul against the crowd's swell so that it is not carried off.

name: Slack Water
description: Let a rushing soul touch slide past by going slack at the exact moment it lands.

name: Under Current
description: Feel the hidden current beneath a crowd's surface mood and learn who drives it.

name: Drag Tide
description: Pull against a foe's own flow of soul so that the foe stumbles in mind and in step.

name: Tide Mend
description: Wash the dregs of fear and panic out of one ally's soul after a crowd has crushed it.

name: Rising Tide
description: Let the sensing soul rise like a tide over a whole district and read every soul it covers.

name: Sinking Undertow
description: Drag the soul of one foe down and back so that the foe's limbs slow as if wading in deep water.

name: Pin Point
description: Fix the sensing soul on a single point and learn exactly what stands there.

name: Held Notice
description: Hold bare attention on one matter for a long while without letting the soul drift.

name: Attention Spare
description: Spare a thread of attention for the user's own back so that nothing creeps up unnoticed.

name: Deaf Ward
description: Go deaf to every soul but the one watched so that no distraction can break the hold.

name: Wide Notice
description: Spread perfect attention across a whole street so that no motion within it goes unmarked.

name: Focus Return
description: Lift the scatter and dullness from an ally's mind so that the ally's attention returns whole.

name: Total Notice
description: Hold the sensing soul on a full field of souls so that not one shift of mood or step escapes it.

name: Notice Lend
description: Lend the user's steady attention to every ally in reach so that all of them notice more and tire less.

name: Doubled Spark
description: Kindle two sparks of soul at once and read what lies between them.

name: Paired Glow
description: Hold two soft glows side by side so that one reveals what the other leaves in shadow.

name: Lantern Match
description: Match the strength of both lanterns so that neither outshines and blinds the other.

name: Pair Guard
description: Set one lantern before the mind and one behind it so that a soul touch finds light on both sides.

name: Twin Beam
description: Cross two beams of soul on one target and read its depth from where they meet.

name: Pair Link
description: Link the sensing of the user and one ally so that each feels what the other feels at a distance.

name: Glow Mend
description: Pour a soft glow over an ally's soul to melt away the chill of a draining touch.

name: Twin Sweep
description: Sweep both lanterns across a wide ground in opposite arcs and leave no soul unlit.

name: Twin Lance
description: Drive two lances of soul light into one foe's mind a heartbeat apart so that the second lands where the first has opened.

name: Raptor Eye
description: Look down on a field of souls as a hawk does and pick out the one that moves wrong.

name: Height Look
description: Lift the sensing soul high above the user so that it sees over every obstacle.

name: Stoop Mark
description: Mark one soul from above and keep it marked as the crowd shifts beneath.

name: Talon Ward
description: Close hooked talons of soul round the mind so that a grasping touch is caught and held off.

name: Circling Gaze
description: Circle the gaze round a target slowly and read it from every side.

name: Gaze Sting
description: Stoop a sharp point of soul onto one foe's mind from the unguarded side.

name: Far Hawk
description: Send the gaze on a long flight over a wide country and bring back the souls it passed.

name: Pinning Gaze
description: Fasten the gaze on one foe so hard that the foe cannot look away and cannot move.

name: Stone Brim
description: Let the soul fill slowly like a stone basin until it holds more than it did.

name: Flowing Sense
description: Let the sensing soul run out along a street like a river and read both its banks.

name: Silt Feel
description: Feel the fine traces that souls leave on the ground and learn who passed and when.

name: Limit Mark
description: Mark the far edge of the sensing river so that the user knows where it ends.

name: Spin Aside
description: Turn an attacking soul touch into a small eddy that spins away from the user.

name: Fullness Read
description: Read how full the soul of a person is and learn how much strength remains.

name: Course Draw
description: Draw the course of a moving crowd as a line on the mind and project where it will pass.

name: Silt Lull
description: Let the muddied soul of one ally settle until the water of it runs clear again.

name: Flood Sense
description: Let the basin overflow into a wide flood that reads every soul across the land it covers.

name: Brimming Burst
description: Loose all that the basin holds in one wave of soul force that jars every foe within its sweep.

name: Oath Ear
description: Listen for the weight of a sworn word in a soul and learn that an oath is held.

name: Sworn Word
description: Feel whether the words a person speaks sit true on the soul that speaks them.

name: Vow Steady
description: Steady the user's soul on a sworn word so that fear cannot shake the hold on it.

name: Troth Ward
description: Stand the soul on a kept oath as on firm ground so that hostile pressure slides off it.

name: Truth Hark
description: Hark to a speaker's soul through a long talk and mark every point where it strains against the words.

name: Oath Mend
description: Ease the sick weight of guilt from an ally who kept faith at a cost.

name: Oath Reading
description: Read every oath that binds a person and learn to whom each is owed and how strongly it holds.

name: Sworn Reply
description: Hand a hostile soul touch back along its own line with the weight of the oath behind it.

name: Bearing Draw
description: Take a bearing on a chosen soul and fix its direction in the mind.

name: Heading Hold
description: Hold the bearing steady while the target moves and while the user moves.

name: Heading Trim
description: Trim the sensing soul to a narrow heading so that it reaches farther along one line.

name: Drifting Guard
description: Let a hostile soul touch drift off its bearing by a slight turn of the user's own.

name: Cross Bearing
description: Take two bearings from two points and learn exactly where a hidden soul lies.

name: Bearing Fix
description: Fix a bearing on one ally so that the user can find that ally in any press or dark.

name: Course Clear
description: Clear the confusion of lost direction from an ally who has been turned about by a soul trick.

name: Sure Bearing
description: Hold a true bearing on every soul in a wide ground at once and never lose one.

name: Heading Lock
description: Lock the bearing of one foe's soul in place so that the foe cannot hide or slip away unfelt.

name: Open Mind
description: Leave the mind open on every side so that any soul that draws near is felt at once.

name: Free Reach
description: Let the sensing soul roam without a set course and report whatever it meets.

name: Wide Open
description: Widen the mind's openness one step more so that fainter souls come into feeling.

name: Windlike Guard
description: Give way before a hard soul touch like grass in a gust and let it pass over.

name: Unwalled Ken
description: Hold the open mind in a steady wide sweep that no hidden soul can cross unfelt.

name: Breeze Clear
description: Blow a clean breath of soul through an ally's mind to carry off lingering taint.

name: Boundless Ken
description: Let the open mind spread without a limit and read every soul on the wind for a great distance.

name: Calling Home
description: Call an ally's soul home along the open mind when the ally has collapsed with breath and pulse gone.
